title: Structural Elucidation of a New Sesquiterpene Compound From Dendrobium nobile Lindl. by NMR Spectroscopy and Electronic Circular Dichroism Calculations
abstract: ABSTRACT                                        A chemical investigation of the 95% EtOH extract of                     Dendrobium nobile                     Lindl. led to the isolation of one new sesquiterpene component (                     1                     ), together with one known compound (                     2                     ). Its structure was completely and unambiguously assigned by 1D and 2D NMR spectra (                     1                     H NMR,                     13                     C NMR, HSQC, HMBC, COSY, and NOESY), and HR‐ESI‐MS spectroscopic analysis and the absolute configuration was confirmed by ECD calculation.
